address: 59 Le Hong Phong Street, Phuoc Ninh Ward, Hai Chau District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: Open from 6am-1pm, this no-frills shop is packed with people craving their fix of mì quảng. The flavoursome orange-red broth is made with shrimps, and you can top your noodles with a choice of quail egg, pork, shrimp, meatball or springy jelly fish....
